name: ActionSheet
summary: Mobile-only choice sheet. Bottom-anchored list of 2-6 large-tap actions with one optional destructive action and a mandatory Cancel button. Apple HIG / iOS-flavor. Distinct from DropdownMenu (desktop, item granularity), Sheet (free-form content), and Dialog (centered decision).

title.description: Small title above the action list (~type.label.sm, text.tertiary). Use to phrase the choice ('Move conversation to…').

actions.description: Array of action descriptors: { label, onSelect, danger?, icon?, disabled? }. Order from most common to least common; place the destructive action LAST in the visible list (before Cancel).

rules: Each action is a button. Danger action has aria-label that includes 'destructive' (e.g. 'Delete conversation, destructive action').
The Cancel button is the LAST focusable and is separated from the action list by a small gap (visual + semantic).
On iOS, ActionSheet content is bottom-aligned in the safe-area; the gap between the list and Cancel respects safe-area-inset-bottom.

do: Use ActionSheet for 2-6 single-tap actions on mobile.
Order most common first; destructive LAST in the list (before Cancel).
Lead each action with a verb.
Use a leading lucide icon next to each action label.
dont: Don't use ActionSheet on desktop — use DropdownMenu.
Don't pack more than 6 actions — paginate or move to a Sheet.
Don't allow two destructive actions in one sheet.
Don't skip Cancel — it's required for the gesture to feel reversible.

changelog.note: Initial ActionSheet contract. Mobile-only. Mandatory Cancel. Destructive-last ordering.
